lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill region, with 3-5 spots per column in the mid-lateral zone forming a localized grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white spots, most prominently in the mid-body region, creating distinct grid-like anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 7 high-luminance blobs distributed in an irregular, low-density pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small commensal fish (likely remoras) positioned ventrally near the pectoral fin and along the lower flank.
